detached_no_commit: Detached HEAD: switch to a branch to commit
push_new: {branch} is not on the remote yet: it is created on origin under the same name and tracked from now on.
push_never_force: Never forced: if the remote has newer commits, the push stops and says so.
switch_dirty_one: {count} uncommitted change goes along. If the other branch has that file differently, nothing is switched and the file is listed.
switch_dirty_other: {count} uncommitted changes go along. If the other branch has any of those files differently, nothing is switched and they are listed.
drop_confirm: “{message}” is deleted and cannot be brought back from here.
refused_old_node: Persona on that computer is too old for this: update it
refused_git_detached: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch first
refused_git_nothing_staged: Nothing is staged: check the files to commit
refused_git_hook_failed: The commit was refused (a hook, usually pre-commit)
refused_git_identity: Git on that computer has no name and email to commit with
refused_git_no_upstream: This branch has no upstream yet
refused_git_no_remote: No remote named origin to push to
refused_git_push_rejected: The remote has newer commits: pull first, then push
refused_git_auth: The remote refused the credentials on that computer
refused_git_conflict: Uncommitted changes would be overwritten: commit or stash these first
refused_git_busy: Another Git command is running there (the agent's?): try again in a moment
refused_git_no_branch: No such branch, or that name can't be used
refused_git_no_stash: Nothing to stash, or that stash is gone
refused_no_gh: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed on that computer
refused_not_signed_in: GitHub CLI (gh) is not signed in on that computer: run gh auth login there
refused_git_not_pushed: Push the branch first: a pull request needs every commit on GitHub
refused_git_no_pr: This branch has no pull request
refused_git_not_github: This repository has no GitHub remote
stash_old_node: Update Persona on this computer to apply, pop or drop stashes safely.
refused_git_stash_stale: The stash list changed. Refresh and select the stash again.
refused_git_stash_unsupported: Safe stash removal is unavailable for this repository.
